```yaml
name: Database CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

jobs:
  lint-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18.x]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Linting
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run Type Checking
        run: npm run type-check

      - name: Run Unit Tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Verify No Try-Catch in App and Jobs
        run: |
          # Check for try-catch blocks in app and jobs packages
          # This is a heuristic check to ensure the PR requirements are met
          if grep -r "try {" packages/app/src/ --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" || \
             grep -r "try {" packages/jobs/src/ --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx"; then
            echo "::error::Found try-catch blocks in app or jobs packages. Please remove them as per PR requirements."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "No try-catch blocks found in app and jobs packages."
```
